info.description: Start Inventory (8081), Payment (8082), and Order (8080). Run folders in order: Inventory, Order, Payment. Tests save generated IDs automatically. Each run creates orders and simulated payments. Stock is checked only; payment is simulated. Run Create confirmed order first if sending dependent requests individually.
info.name: Order Management - Three Microservices

exec: pm.test('Seeded products exist', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.sku)).to.include.members(['MOUSE', 'LAPTOP', 'KEYBOARD']); });
pm.test('Stock and price', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.available).to.eql(true); pm.expect(p.unitPrice).to.eql(25); pm.expect(p.stock).to.eql(50); });

pm.test('Confirmed total and payment', function () { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(50); pm.expect(o.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(o.paymentId).to.be.a('number'); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', o.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderPaymentId', o.paymentId); });
pm.test('Saved order', function () { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(o.id)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId'))); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); });

item.name: Verify payment created by Order Service

exec: pm.test('Payment matches order', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(p.orderId)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId'))); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(p.amount).to.eql(50); });
pm.test('Rejected without payment', function () { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(o.paymentId).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('Approved', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(p.amount).to.eql(25); pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentId', p.id); });
